title: Lecture 1 - How to Start a Startup (Sam Altman, Dustin Moskovitz)
summary: The opening lecture of the How to Start a Startup course at Stanford, with Sam Altman covering ideas and products and Dustin Moskovitz discussing why to start a startup.
why: HN commenters recommend the series as timeless startup advice from strong speakers, and cite specific points from Altman and Moskovitz.

quote.text: Amazing set of speakers and pretty timeless advice for starting a startup
